title: Protocol for separation of the nuclear and the cytoplasmic fractions of Xenopus laevis embryonic cells for studying protein shuttling
protocol: Inject Xenopus embryos at the 2–4 cell stage with synthetic mRNAs (300-400 pg per blastomere).
Incubate injected embryos up to stage 12 gastrula.
Incubate X. laevis embryos at room temperature until they reach the gastrula stage.
Pretreat embryos by incubating them in 0.1× MMR containing 150 mg/mL cycloheximide for 1 hour at 23°C.
Collect live embryos carefully into a 1.5-mL Eppendorf tube.
Carefully collect all liquid using a pipette with a fine tip.
Centrifuge the Eppendorf tube containing embryos for 10 min at 14000 g and 4°C to obtain a crude extract.
Dilute the resulting extract 10-fold in N-buffer (300 μL) with the addition of protease inhibitors cocktail (Sigma-Aldrich, Critical Reagent) at a dilution of 1:50.
Pellet nuclei by centrifugation at 5000 g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Wash pellet with a solution containing 0.253 g sucrose per mL of buffer N, in a volume of 0.5–1 mL.
Centrifuge washed pellet at 14000 g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Repeat wash and centrifugation steps up to four times if necessary.
Resuspend nuclei in 300 μL of buffer E containing protease inhibitors (diluted 1:50).
Incubate the suspension on a rotator for 45 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge the nuclear extract at 14000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant as the nuclear extract.
Increase the KCl concentration in the supernatant to 150 mM by adding 150 μL of 1 M KCl per 1 mL of buffer N.
Centrifuge the mixture at 14000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate the diluted extract with 1% NP-40 (10 μL per 1 mL) on a rotator for 45 minutes.
Centrifuge the incubated mixture at 14000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Precipitate the protein fraction from the extracts with methanol-chloroform.
Add equal volumes of methanol and chloroform to the resulting extract in 1.5-mL Eppendorf tubes.
Mix by inversion or vortexing vigorously.
Centrifuge the mixture for 5 minutes at 10000 g.
Divide the mixture into two phases; the precipitated protein forms a film between the phases.
Carefully remove the upper methanol-chloroform phase to avoid removing the protein film.
Add a triple volume of methanol (900–1000 μL) to the Eppendorf tube and mix.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 10000 g.
Air-dry the protein precipitate collected in the tube for 1-2 hours, depending on the mass of the pellet.
Dissolve the dried pellet in 100 μL of 2× Laemmli SDS sample buffer.
Boil the samples for 10 minutes at 80°C.
Store the boiled samples at -20°C until use.
Analyze the samples by SDS-PAGE followed by Western blotting.
Detect Myc-tagged Ybx1 using monoclonal anti-Myc alkaline phosphatase conjugated antibodies.
Detect Zyxin using rabbit polyclonal monospecific antibodies for Zyxin.
